```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

db_path = if (file.exists("data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db")) {
  "data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
} else {
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
}

con = DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)
listings     = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |> tibble::as_tibble()
availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
reviews      = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |> tibble::as_tibble()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

```{r}
host_counts = listings |> 
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings_count")

listings_t1 = listings |> 
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

a1 = host_counts |> 
  dplyr::filter(host_listings_count >= 10) |> 
  nrow()

a2 = listings_t1 |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    pct = mean(host_listings_count >= 10) * 100
  )

a1
a2
```

```{r}
task2 = listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(price_per_person = price / accommodates) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |> 
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 20) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price_pp = median(price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |> 
  dplyr::slice_min(median_price_pp, n = 1)

task2
```

```{r}
task3 = listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities", room_type == "Entire home/apt")

task3
```

```{r}
task4 = listings |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d), .by_group = TRUE) |> 
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::row_number() <= ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    top10_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::left_join(
    listings |> 
      dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
      dplyr::summarize(total_revenue = sum(estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "city"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(pct_top10 = (top10_revenue / total_revenue) * 100) |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus")

task4
```

```{r}
task5 = availability |> 
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10") |> 
  dplyr::right_join(
    listings |> dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt"),
    by = "id"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    share_mostly_taken = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

task5
```

```{r}
task6 = reviews |> 
  dplyr::filter(month >= "2025-07" & month <= "2026-06") |> 
  dplyr::left_join(listings |> dplyr::select(id, city), by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |> 
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    busiest_month = month[which.max(total_reviews)],
    ratio = max(total_reviews) / min(total_reviews)
  )

task6
```

```{r}
task7 = listings |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |> 
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |> 
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  dplyr::select(city, host_is_superhost, median_price) |> 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = host_is_superhost, values_from = median_price) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(superhost_premium = t - f)

task7
```

```{r}
lost_listings = listings |> 
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

a10 = nrow(lost_listings)

city_losses = lost_listings |> 
  dplyr::count(city) |> 
  dplyr::slice_max(n, n = 1)

a10
city_losses
```
